hypothesis: A different regression pretraining prior may give complementary conditional-mean estimates. For binaryY, E[(Y-p)^2|X] is minimized atP(Y=1|X), so the population target is a probability. This is a theoretical motivation, not evidence that TabICL regression improves this competition.
source_support: Official implementation supplies a separate TabICLv2 regression checkpoint and sklearn-compatible regressor. No source claim about binary-target superiority is made.
novelty: Earlier39archived TabICL jobs use TabICLClassifier in the executed foundation.py. This branch changes pretrained target/task prior, not seed or filename.
protocol: Identical frozen70k5fold context50000/head6000/evaluation14000; compact90 feature view and unchanged correction18/spline77 pipeline.
falsification: Full OOF KS/AUC/logloss/Brier and allfold stability against repairedKumo90 and classificationTabICL; reject degradation. No partial-fold outcome selection.
search: One preregistered pipeline and one fixed20percent blend; no hyperparameter or clip-level tuning.
limitations: Historical labels reused; binary targets differ from typical continuous regression pretraining; clipping may create ties and poor calibration. Retain unclipped predictions and clipping counts.
